info.name: USDA NASS QuickStats Parameters Statistics API

params.name: key
params.description: API key obtained by registering at the QuickStats API portal.

params.name: commodity_desc
params.description: Commodity description (e.g., CORN, SOYBEANS, CATTLE).

params.name: class_desc
params.description: Commodity class description.

params.name: statisticcat_desc
params.description: Statistical category (e.g., AREA HARVESTED, PRODUCTION, PRICE RECEIVED).

params.name: unit_desc
params.description: Unit of measurement (e.g., ACRES, BU, HEAD).

params.name: sector_desc
params.description: Sector or division of the agricultural economy.

params.name: group_desc
params.description: Commodity group description (e.g., FIELD CROPS, VEGETABLES).

params.name: state_alpha
params.description: Two-letter state abbreviation (e.g., VA, IA, TX).

params.name: state_name
params.description: Full state name.

params.name: county_name
params.description: County name.

params.name: agg_level_desc
params.description: Geographic aggregation level (NATIONAL, STATE, COUNTY, ZIP CODE).

params.name: year
params.description: Survey year (e.g., 2023). Supports operators like year__GE=2010.

params.name: year__GE
params.description: Year greater than or equal to specified value.

params.name: year__LE
params.description: Year less than or equal to specified value.

params.name: freq_desc
params.description: Data collection frequency (ANNUAL, MONTHLY, WEEKLY, POINT IN TIME, SEASONAL).

params.name: reference_period_desc
params.description: Reference period description (e.g., YEAR, JAN, JUN).

params.name: format
params.description: Response format (JSON, XML, CSV). Defaults to JSON.

params.name: callback
params.description: JSONP callback function name for cross-origin requests.

items.docs: Retrieves agricultural statistics data records from the Quick Stats database. Supports filtering by commodity, location, time period, and statistical category using comparison operators. Returns up to 50,000 records per request. Response formats include JSON (default), XML, and CSV.

params.name: key
params.description: API key.

params.name: commodity_desc
params.description: Commodity description to count records for.

params.name: state_alpha
params.description: State abbreviation to filter.

params.name: year__GE
params.description: Year filter (greater than or equal).

items.docs: Returns the total count of records that would be returned by a given query without fetching the actual data. Useful for validating queries before making full data requests, particularly to ensure results stay within the 50,000 record limit.
